baseline.identity: byte-copy of bots/fafnir-v01-phalanx, sha256 in tools/newton/frozen.json

screen32.inherited: byte-identical source, deterministic engine, fixtures identical to configs/newton/screen.toml

parity.requirement: mechanism-off reproduces x01 exactly on >=2 spot fixtures (outcome, rounds, reason, final counters)

screen.requirement: >= +2 net wins vs 25-7 on the 32 shared fixtures AND no map cell worse by >= 2

advance.requirement: screen AND compact gates both pass

gauntlet.requirement: >= +3 vs 140-42 AND no map cell worse by >= 3 AND big_empty >= 12-2 AND stronghold >= 12-2

judge.requirement: sandbox vs hunter-v22 on arena+stronghold both sides: 0 TLE, 0 faults, 0 errors

promote.requirement: ALL gates pass; otherwise record honestly, never relax

notes: Deterministic fixtures are paired exactly, never pooled as independent samples. Mechanism arms carry their own activation counters; an inactive mechanism on a gate set is an activation finding, not a pass. Combos only after singles, evaluated as 2x2 against both parents and x01.
